subject: Run and publish the ten SDL 3.0 case notebooks
description: Make notebooks/sdl3-cases (010-100) run end to end from this repo, execute all ten with papermill as ICE jobs, keep the executed notebooks with their outputs, and prepare their move to DigitalEarthSweden/digital-earth-sweden-community. Publishing outside this repo needs Tobias's explicit OK. Needed so the SDL final report (due 23 Nov 2026) can list the notebook library as delivered. Full brief: .agents/handoffs/0011/.
